cohort: 31,676 births after the 28th week of gestation at Filantropia Clinical Hospital of Bucharest between 2005 and 2015
finding: The study found a dramatic decrease in the rate of cesarean sections performed for stillbirths over the 10-year period, suggesting a shift towards evidence-based guidelines and potentially reflecting a decrease in preventable stillbirths.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections in stillbirths decreased dramatically over the study period.
